records.report: MRI knee The following sequences were applied combined with a multichannell phased array coil, in a 3Tesla Scanner: T1, FS PD, T2* and contrast-enhanced FS T1. FIndings Joint effusion is shown on both knee joints, extending into the suprapatellar joint space. Enhancing synovitis is shown on both knee joints, more prominent on the right side. Menisci, ligamentous structures, bone marrow and articular cartilage do not show any abnormalities. Conclusion The findings suggest bilateral inflammatory arthritis. PS. The findings were confirmed with Ultrasound examination, performed on the same day, which showed the effusion and the synovitis, without however significant hyperemia.
